name: Joseph Zada
bio:
Joseph Cumpston (born July 21, 2005), known professionally as Joseph Zada, is an Australian actor. He has appeared in television series such as Total Control (2024) and Stan Australia series Invisible Boys (2025), as well as Australian movies Bilched (2019) and The Speedway Murders (2023). He featured in the series We Were Liars (2025) and East of Eden (2026), and stars in the Lionsgate movie adaptation of Sunrise on the Reaping (2026), a prequel to The Hunger Games, as Haymitch Abernathy.

credits.title: Bilched
credits.overview: A wild ride through the last days of high school with our anti-hero Hal alongside his slacker/jock mates. Amongst the hilarious universal teenage stupidity and chaos of the penultimate end of school house party it becomes glaringly obvious Hal needs to stop cruising through life to face his fears and follow his heart.
